about.description: Hyperliquid is a high-performance, fully on-chain Layer 1 blockchain optimized for perpetual derivatives, founded by Jeff Yan (ex-Hudson River Trading) and self-funded with ZERO venture-capital allocation. The validator-operated perp market is one of the largest decentralized perpetual exchanges by volume globally, with quarterly protocol fees reaching $287M in Q4 2025 and $215M in Q1 2026. The validator-operated namespace includes crypto majors plus select RWA markets (gold, oil, FX, indices). Hyperliquid's HIP-3 framework, launched on mainnet October 13, 2025, enabled permissionless builder-deployed perpetual markets — trade[XYZ], ABCD, ADEN, Ventuals, Paragon, Markets by Kinetiq, HyENA, Felix, and Flash Trade all run as HIP-3 namespaces hosting niche RWA markets (S&P 500, stocks, ETFs, GPU rentals, pre-IPO names). HIP-3 OI surpassed $1.43B within months of launch, with tokenized stocks and commodities representing 23 of the top 30 trading pairs on Hyperliquid. RWA price-discovery role validated: silver perps exceeded $3.5B volume during Jan 2026 volatility; oil perps surpassed $2B following March 2026 geopolitical events. HIP-4 (event/outcome contracts) launched May 2, 2026, opening prediction markets. HYPE is the native gas + fee-capture token: ~99% of protocol trading fees flow to the Assistance Fund, which buys back HYPE from the open market (~$65M monthly buyback at recent run-rate). Total supply 1B HYPE with zero VC allocation — entirely community + team distribution; HYPE launched November 2024 via airdrop. HyperEVM smart-contract layer launched in 2025 enables permissionless DeFi on top of the same validator set. Hyperliquid Strategies (institutional treasury vehicle) and Unit Labs activated a co-operated validator on May 11, 2026, reinforcing institutional decentralization.
about.registryInfo: Hyperliquid is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain purpose-built for on-chain derivatives, developed by Hyperliquid Labs and governed by the Hyper Foundation. Founded by Jeff Yan (CEO, ex-Hudson River Trading), the team consists primarily of former high-frequency traders. Self-funded with ZERO venture-capital allocation. HYPE token launched November 2024 as both gas token and primary fee-revenue beneficiary. Hyperliquid operates its own validator network for matching and settlement, with EVM-compatible HyperEVM execution layer for smart contracts. HIP-3 framework allows third-party builder-deployers to launch their own perpetual namespaces on top of Hyperliquid infrastructure.

fees.revenueNotes: Hyperliquid validator-operated perpetual fees (Tier 0): 1.5 bps maker / 4.5 bps taker. Maker rebates scale with 14-day rolling weighted volume — top tier (>$500M 14d volume) receives -0.3 bps maker rebate. Tier updates daily UTC, with spot volume counting 2x toward fee tier calculation. Aligned-quote-asset markets benefit from 20% lower taker fees, 50% better maker rebates, and 20% greater volume contribution. NEW perp markets in Growth Mode have all-in fees reduced by ~90% (taker drops to ~0.45 bps). Spot markets: 7 bps taker / 2 bps maker (Tier 0). HIP-3 builder-deployed perps (trade[XYZ], ABCD, ADEN, Ventuals, Paragon, Markets by Kinetiq, HyENA, Felix, Flash Trade) charge 2x these rates (~3 bps maker / ~9 bps taker standard, ~0.45-0.9 bps in Growth Mode), with 50% of fees going to the deployer and 50% to the protocol. Approximately 99% of protocol-side fee revenue flows to the Assistance Fund for HYPE buybacks (~$65M/month at recent run-rate). HYPE has zero VC allocation. RECENT MILESTONES: (1) Q4 2025 protocol fees $287M peak. (2) Oct 13, 2025: HIP-3 mainnet launch. (3) Q1 2026 protocol fees $215M. (4) Jan 2026: Silver perp volume >$3.5B during volatility. (5) Mar 2026: Oil perp volume >$2B post-geopolitical events. (6) May 2, 2026: HIP-4 outcome/prediction-market contracts launched. (7) May 11, 2026: Hyperliquid Strategies x Unit Labs validator activated. NOTE: GMTrade is a separate Solana-based perp DEX (GMX-DAO approved), NOT a HIP-3 namespace. Source: https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/trading/fees
